import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem aime_1983_p9_mutation
  (x : ℝ)
  (S : Set ℝ)
  (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (h₀ : f = fun x ↦ (9 * (x ^ 2 * Real.sin x ^ 2) + 4) / (x * Real.sin x))
  (h₁ : S = Set.Ioo 0 Real.pi) :
  ∀ y ∈ Set.image f S,
    12 ≤ y ∧
      (y = 12 ↔ ∃ z ∈ S, z * Real.sin z = 2 / 3 ∧ y = f z) := by
  intro y hy
  rcases hy with ⟨z, hzS, hzy⟩
  have hzS' : z ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := by
    rw [h₁] at hzS
    exact hzS
  rcases hzS' with ⟨hz_pos, hz_lt_pi⟩
  have hsin_pos : 0 < Real.sin z := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hz_pos hz_lt_pi
  have hz_sin_pos : 0 < z * Real.sin z := mul_pos hz_pos hsin_pos
  set t := z * Real.sin z with ht_def
  have hft : f z = (9 * t ^ 2 + 4) / t := by
    rw [h₀]
    calc
      (9 * (z ^ 2 * Real.sin z ^ 2) + 4) / (z * Real.sin z) =
          (9 * ((z * Real.sin z) ^ 2) + 4) / (z * Real.sin z) := by ring
      _ = (9 * t ^ 2 + 4) / t := by rw [ht_def]
  have h_fz_ge_12 : 12 ≤ f z := by
    rw [hft]
    have ht_pos' : 0 < t := hz_sin_pos
    have h_nonneg_sq : 0 ≤ (3 * t - 2) ^ 2 := pow_two_nonneg _
    have h_eq : (9 * t ^ 2 + 4) / t - 12 = ((3 * t - 2) ^ 2) / t := by
      field_simp [ht_pos'.ne.symm]
      ring
    have h_nonneg_div : 0 ≤ ((3 * t - 2) ^ 2) / t :=
      div_nonneg h_nonneg_sq (by positivity)
    linarith
  have h_fz_eq_12_iff : f z = 12 ↔ t = 2 / 3 := by
    constructor
    · intro h_eq12
      rw [hft] at h_eq12
      have ht_pos' : 0 < t := hz_sin_pos
      field_simp [ht_pos'.ne.symm] at h_eq12
      have h_sq_eq_zero : (3 * t - 2) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        nlinarith
      nlinarith
    · intro ht_eq
      rw [hft, ht_eq]
      norm_num
  have hy_eq_fz : y = f z := hzy.symm
  have h_12_le_y : 12 ≤ y := by
    rw [hy_eq_fz]
    exact h_fz_ge_12
  have h_iff : (y = 12 ↔ ∃ z' ∈ S, z' * Real.sin z' = 2 / 3 ∧ y = f z') := by
    constructor
    · intro hy12
      rw [hy_eq_fz] at hy12
      have ht_eq : t = 2 / 3 := (h_fz_eq_12_iff.mp hy12)
      refine ⟨z, hzS, ?_, hzy.symm⟩
      rw [ht_def] at ht_eq
      exact ht_eq
    · intro ⟨z', hz'S, hz'_sin_eq, hy'_fz⟩
      rw [hy'_fz]
      rw [h₀]
      calc
        (9 * (z' ^ 2 * Real.sin z' ^ 2) + 4) / (z' * Real.sin z') =
            (9 * ((z' * Real.sin z') ^ 2) + 4) / (z' * Real.sin z') := by ring
        _ = (9 * ((2 / 3 : ℝ) ^ 2) + 4) / (2 / 3) := by rw [hz'_sin_eq]
        _ = 12 := by norm_num
  exact And.intro h_12_le_y h_iff

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem aime_1983_p9_mutation
  (x : ℝ)
  (S : Set ℝ)
  (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (h₀ : f = fun x ↦ (9 * (x ^ 2 * Real.sin x ^ 2) + 4) / (x * Real.sin x))
  (h₁ : S = Set.Ioo 0 Real.pi) :
  ∀ y ∈ Set.image f S,
    12 ≤ y ∧
      (y = 12 ↔ ∃ z ∈ S, z * Real.sin z = 2 / 3 ∧ y = f z) := by
  intro y hy
  rw [Set.mem_image] at hy
  obtain ⟨z, hzS0, hfz⟩ := hy
  have hzIoo : z ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := by
    have h' := hzS0
    rw [h₁] at h'
    exact h'
  have hz_pos : 0 < z := hzIoo.1
  have hz_lt_pi : z < Real.pi := hzIoo.2
  have hsin_pos : 0 < Real.sin z := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hz_pos hz_lt_pi
  have ht_pos : 0 < z * Real.sin z := mul_pos hz_pos hsin_pos
  have ht_ne : z * Real.sin z ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht_pos
  have hfz_rw : f z = (9 * (z ^ 2 * Real.sin z ^ 2) + 4) / (z * Real.sin z) := by
    rw [h₀]
  have hy_eq : y = (9 * (z ^ 2 * Real.sin z ^ 2) + 4) / (z * Real.sin z) := by
    calc y = f z := hfz.symm
      _ = (9 * (z ^ 2 * Real.sin z ^ 2) + 4) / (z * Real.sin z) := hfz_rw
  have h_pow_eq : z ^ 2 * Real.sin z ^ 2 = (z * Real.sin z) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hy_eq_t : y = (9 * (z * Real.sin z) ^ 2 + 4) / (z * Real.sin z) := by
    rw [hy_eq, h_pow_eq]
  have h12 : 12 ≤ y := by
    rw [hy_eq_t]
    have h_le : 12 * (z * Real.sin z) ≤ 9 * (z * Real.sin z) ^ 2 + 4 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (3 * (z * Real.sin z) - 2)]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ ht_pos).mpr h_le
  have h_iff : y = 12 ↔ ∃ w ∈ S, w * Real.sin w = 2 / 3 ∧ y = f w := by
    constructor
    · intro hy12
      refine ⟨z, hzS0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have ht_eq : (9 * (z * Real.sin z) ^ 2 + 4) / (z * Real.sin z) = 12 := by
          rw [← hy_eq_t, hy12]
        have h_mul : 9 * (z * Real.sin z) ^ 2 + 4 = 12 * (z * Real.sin z) := by
          rwa [div_eq_iff ht_ne] at ht_eq
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (3 * (z * Real.sin z) - 2)]
      · exact hfz.symm
    · rintro ⟨w, hwS0, hw_t, hw_y⟩
      have hfw_rw : f w = (9 * (w ^ 2 * Real.sin w ^ 2) + 4) / (w * Real.sin w) := by
        rw [h₀]
      have h_pow_eq_w : w ^ 2 * Real.sin w ^ 2 = (w * Real.sin w) ^ 2 := by ring
      have hfw_t : f w = (9 * (w * Real.sin w) ^ 2 + 4) / (w * Real.sin w) := by
        rw [hfw_rw, h_pow_eq_w]
      have hfw_12 : f w = 12 := by
        rw [hfw_t, hw_t]
        norm_num
      rw [hw_y, hfw_12]
  exact ⟨h12, h_iff⟩
